chunks: This is the Book, free of doubt, a guidance for those who preserve themselves from evil.
ai.seo_question: What is the Quran described as in the opening verse of Surah Al-Baqarah?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse establishes the Quran's absolute certainty (yaqin) and its exclusive utility for the muttaqin, whose piety is defined by deep spiritual awareness and adherence to the Ahl al-Bayt. It underscores that the Quran is not merely a text for general reading but a living guide that requires the inner purity of the God-conscious to unlock its deeper layers of meaning.
